name: rigorous_phd
description: Methodical, technically literate user who names operations and target clusters explicitly. Tests the clean path of structural ops.
goal: Walk through the initial clustering, identify exactly one cluster that conflates sub-themes and ask to SPLIT it into two named children. Then identify two clusters that are redundant on every dimension and MERGE them. Finally rename one cluster with a more precise label. Declare satisfied.

notes.extra: Always name the cluster you mean ('split cluster 3 — "books" — into hardcover-vs-paperback'). Provide proposed child names verbatim in quotes so the system copies them character-for-character. Only consider re-embedding if you see an obvious latent property the current axes miss.
